drawSlidesCode.browserPath.description: The path of the program of a Chrome, an Edge or a Chromium, with which the commands that build a presentation export its pages and print its PDF. When this setting is empty, the build launches the first that starts of the Chromium that the command Install Chromium for the Build installs, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and the programs chromium, chromium-browser, google-chrome and google-chrome-stable of the PATH. Only the user settings set it, because the build runs the program.

drawSlidesCode.listStyles.description: The style of each level of a bulleted and of a numbered list that the list buttons of draw.io make, and the gap above each item but the first of a first level. A level deeper than the lists give takes the last style. The editor follows a change of this setting without a reload. The build of a deck reads the same setting.

marker.description: The `list-style-type` of the list, such as `disclosure-closed` or `'-  '`.

color.description: The color of the marker, as CSS, such as `#004D80`, or the name of a color of `drawSlidesCode.colors`, such as `accent`.

size.description: The size of the marker, as CSS, such as `0.7em`.

drawSlidesCode.listMarkers.description: The markers of the menu List style, each as its `list-style-type` and its name. The marker `template` gives a list the style of its level again. The editor follows a change of this setting without a reload.

drawSlidesCode.templates.description: The template files of a deck, multi-page draw.io files whose pages are the layouts of its slides, each named by its layout. The menus Insert and Pages of the editor offer Insert slide, which inserts a copy of a layout after the current page. The last part of a path may hold `*`, and a path may hold `${deckFolder}`, the nearest folder above the drawing with a `package.json`, and `${workspaceFolder}`. A relative path is read from the deck folder.

drawSlidesCode.slideSize.description: The size of a slide. The page view keeps a page of this size at one page, as the build cuts each slide at the edge of its page.

drawSlidesCode.languageTool.description: The address of the LanguageTool server that checks the spelling and the grammar of the label being edited. The command Check the Spelling and Grammar of the Presentation and `npm run check` of a presentation check every slide with the same server.

drawSlidesCode.colors.description: The colors of a deck, each a name of letters and digits that starts with a letter and a value `#RRGGBB`. In a drawing whose `drawSlidesCode.slides` is true, the editor defines each color for the formulas of every page, which name it as in `\textcolor{accent}{x}`, names it in the color picker, adds it to the presets of the picker in the order of this setting and follows a change of this setting without a reload. A color of `drawSlidesCode.listStyles` and of `drawSlidesCode.customColorSchemes` may be the name of a color of this setting. The build of a presentation reads the same setting, and the commands Import Colors from TeX and Export Colors to TeX convert the `\definecolor` lines of a TeX file into this setting and back.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: A name of a color is letters and digits and starts with a letter.

additionalProperties.patternErrorMessage: A color is `#` and six hexadecimal digits, such as `#004D80`.

drawSlidesCode.deckStyles.description: The styles of a deck, by kind of geometry: `wire` for an edge, and for a vertex the shape that draw.io draws, such as `rectangle`, `ellipse` or `rhombus`. Each kind is an object of names of letters and digits that start with a letter to style strings of draw.io, such as `"rounded=1;strokeWidth=3;"`, and a name stands for one style across every kind. In a drawing whose `drawSlidesCode.slides` is true, the section Deck styles of the Format panel lists the styles of the kinds of the selected cells, gives one to the selected cells of its kind, saves one from a selected cell, updates every cell of the deck linked to a style, and renames and removes a style. A cell linked to a style holds `deckStyle=<name>` beside the keys of the style. A style holds keys of appearance alone, never the keys of geometry `exitX`, `exitY`, `entryX`, `entryY` and their `Dx`, `Dy` and `Perimeter`, `sourcePort`, `targetPort` and `rotation`, nor the keys `shape` and `perimeter` of its kind.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: A kind is the name of a shape of draw.io, such as `wire`, `rectangle`, `ellipse` or `mxgraph.flowchart.decision`.

drawSlidesCode.customLibraries.title: Custom Libraries
drawSlidesCode.customLibraries.description: Configures the Draw.io editor to use custom libraries.

drawSlidesCode.styles.title: Styles
drawSlidesCode.styles.description: Defines an array of objects that contain the colours (fontColor, fillColor, strokeColor and gradientColor) for the Style tab of the format panel if the selection is empty. These objects can have a commonStyle (which is applied to both vertices and edges), vertexStyle (applied to vertices) and edgeStyle (applied to edges), and a graph with background and gridColor. An empty object means apply the default colors

drawSlidesCode.colorNames.description: Names for colors, eg. {‘FFFFFF’: ‘White’, ‘000000’: ‘Black’} that are used as tooltips (uppercase, no leading # for the colour codes)
